name: stress-initialization
description: Set initial stresses in deformable-block zones directly, or establish gravitational in-situ stresses, before solving. Initial stresses should be consistent with boundary conditions, gravity, and the assigned zone constitutive model. Compression is negative.

methods.name: uniform / anisotropic stress
notes: Components: stress-xx/yy/zz (normal) and stress-xy/xz/yz (shear); the first slot also enumerates stress (full tensor), stress-principal and state (live 9.7).
Use modifier keywords add / gradient / multiply / vary to build depth-varying fields (all four live-enumerated at the post-value slot).

methods.name: gravitational in-situ stress
notes: 'block insitu stress <6 components>' then optional per-axis gradients: live 9.7 slot enumerates gradient-x gradient-y gradient-z nodisplacements — each gradient keyword is followed by the stress-component gradient values (floats).
A bare 'gradient' keyword is REJECTED on live 9.7 ('Unused extra parameter') — use the per-axis form.
'nodisplacements' suppresses displacements during the seating solve and is terminal (no further keywords).

'total' is NOT accepted at the 'block insitu stress' slot on live 9.7 — it belongs to 'block insitu topography' (live sub-keywords: overburden overburden-xx/yy/zz ratio-x/y/z total; requires gravity to be defined).

validation_checks: FISH: block.zone.stress(z) to confirm the assigned field
Solve elastically and confirm small block.gp.force.unbal (near equilibrium)
